summary: Explains the legacy World Composition level-streaming system: folder-scanned streaming levels, the Levels window hierarchy, layers with streaming distances, the minimap, level LODs, world origin shifting and tiled landscape import.
gotchas: Legacy system; World Partition is recommended for UE 5.0+ projects
World origin shifting is not supported in multiplayer games
Level Bounds Actor only works with Realtime enabled in viewports
Actor subclasses storing absolute positions must override ApplyWorldOffset

summary: How to enter Mesh Paint mode and use its four methods (Vertex Color, Vertex Weights, Texture Color, Textures), with paint/erase colors, channels, hotkeys, per-instance painting and caveats for Nanite meshes.
gotchas: Texture Color painting requires Enable virtual texture support in project settings
Nanite meshes do not support per-instance Vertex Color painting; use Texture Color
Per-instance vertex color is not visualized on Nanite meshes; set r.Nanite 0 or Disallow Nanite to view
Erase Color is just a second paint color, not a true eraser

summary: Setup for Texture Color painting: adding a per-instance virtual Mesh Paint Texture with the Add tool, sampling it via MeshPaintTextureObject/MeshPaintTextureReplace, needing unique non-overlapping UVs, and controlling per-mesh/per-instance support and texture resolution.
keys: Mesh paint default static mesh support
gotchas: Requires Virtual Textures enabled; Add tool is grayed out otherwise
Overlapping/tiling UVs cause paint to appear on multiple parts of the mesh
Changing resolution settings does not affect existing textures; use the Fix tool to resize
Only option for painting Nanite meshes per instance

summary: Shows how to copy painted data between Vertex Color and Texture Color modes (From Texture / From Vertex), auto-propagate texture painting to vertex colors, strip mesh paint textures from cooked builds per platform, and build a material that picks between both.
gotchas: Texture-to-vertex copies differ slightly due to texture vs vertex interpolation
Per-instance vertex color on Nanite meshes is not visible unless Nanite is disabled
Set r.MeshPaintVirtualTexture.Support False in a platform ini to strip mesh paint textures

summary: Reference table of every Mesh Paint tool (Select, Paint, Fill, To LODs, To Mesh, Add, Copy/Paste, Import, Fix, etc.) per paint method, plus brush, visualization, weight painting, static mesh/component and virtual texture project settings for mesh paint.
gotchas: Import only accepts TGA images for vertex colors
From Vertex always takes vertex colors from LOD0
Mesh paint texture resource size is not the packaged or in-memory size
Enable Vertex Color Mesh Painting may be set false by Blueprint construction scripts overriding vertex colors

summary: Step-by-step material graph (Texture Sample fed by MeshPaintTextureObject, optional MeshPaintTextureReplace fallback) and Static Mesh Editor steps to generate a unique UV channel and set Mesh Paint Texture Coordinate Index for Texture Color painting.
keys: Overridden Mesh Paint Texture Coordinate Index
gotchas: Texture Sample UVs index must match the mesh's Mesh Paint Texture Coordinate Index or painting looks wrong
UV channel must have no overlapping, tiling or repeating charts

summary: Material recipes using a VertexColor node driving Lerp nodes to blend 2, 3, 4 or 5 textures, matched to the Vertex Weights Texture Weight Type options, and how to paint the layers.
gotchas: Texture Weight Type must match the number of textures blended in the material
5-way blend needs a One Minus (1-x) on alpha for the fifth channel

summary: Short guide to making a material that tints base color by painted vertex color (VertexColor RGB multiplied with albedo) and painting it in Mesh Paint Vertex Color mode.
Explains using the Mesh Paint Fix tool to repair painted vertex colors after a mesh is reimported with a different vertex count, resolving the related map check error.
keys: has hand-painted vertex colors that no longer match the original StaticMesh
gotchas: Fix tool is grayed out unless there is a mismatch to fix
Works well for small topology changes; large changes may not match colors well

summary: Guide to Foliage Mode for painting instanced Static Mesh or Actor foliage onto landscapes and meshes: tools, brush and filter options, cull distance fading, LODs, lighting, density scalability, World Partition foliage grid size, and reattaching instances.
gotchas: Actor Foliage costs the same as normal actors; high densities hurt performance
Nanite-enabled meshes are not affected by cull distance and instance fading
Whole clusters change LOD at once; LODs must share lightmap unwrapping
Default World Partition foliage grid is 256 m, separate from the WP grid

summary: Tutorial for spawning grass automatically on a Landscape: create a Landscape Grass Type, wire Landscape Layer Blend, Landscape Layer Sample and Landscape Grass Output in the landscape material, then paint the grass layer.
gotchas: Grass system only works on Landscape actors
Editor may become unresponsive while grass spawns; lower Grass Density while painting
Uses Open World Demo Collection sample content

summary: Property reference for Foliage Type (mesh, placement, procedural, instance settings, scalability), Landscape Grass Type grass varieties, and Procedural Foliage Spawner simulation settings.
gotchas: Enable Density Scaling should be off for important meshes with collision (e.g. trees)
Use as Occluder may have a negative performance impact

summary: Kite-demo tips: extending grass culling via cull distances and Foliage.MinimumScreenSize, restricting procedural foliage to landscape layers, texture- and math-based grass masking in the landscape material, and grid-aligned crop-style grass placement.
gotchas: Very high cull distances can crash the GPU or editor
Changing Foliage.MinimumScreenSize from default 0.0001 can cause performance problems
Procedural Foliage Volume must be Resimulated to see changes

summary: Quick start for the Procedural Foliage Spawner: enable it in Editor Preferences, create Static Mesh Foliage types, tune collision/shade radius, clustering, growth and cull settings, mix species, and exclude areas with Procedural Foliage Blocking Volume.
gotchas: Must be enabled under Editor Preferences > Experimental
Lighting must be rebuilt after each Resimulate, which can be slow

summary: Step-by-step PCG graph that spawns fence meshes along a Blueprint spline using a grammar string parameter, Subdivide Spline with module info, an extract-bounds subgraph for pivot correction, Match And Set Attributes and Static Mesh Spawner by attribute.
gotchas: Without Accept Incomplete Subdivision the grammar does not fit and nothing spawns
Each symbol needs a Module Info entry and Mesh Info entry at the same index
Requires the Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) plugin

summary: Describes PCG data types: spatial data (volumes, surfaces, lines, points with transform/bounds/color/density/steepness/seed, Polygon 2D and its operators), composite data from set operations, and attribute sets.
gotchas: Landscape Spline data is projected vertically and applies at the surface even if offset

summary: Hub page: links to the PCG fence generator shape grammar guide, PCG generation modes, data types reference, node reference and using PCG with World Partition.

Tools for debugging and profiling PCG runtime generation: debug overlay and generated-cell draw cvars, cache/refresh/enable cvars, per-node Break In Debugger, GPU node debug options, profiling pane, Unreal Insights scopes and GPU kernel profiling.
gotchas: Debug overlay and cell drawing work only in Editor and Development builds by default
Partition actor pool doubling when exhausted is expensive; avoid during gameplay
Cached node results may skip execution; Ctrl-click Force Regen to flush
Profiling pane covers CPU only, not GPU execution

summary: Main PCG intro: concepts, plugin setup, creating PCG graphs and templates, node categories, attributes/metadata domains and selector syntax, overrides, graph parameters and instances, the PCG component and volume, debugging keys, and a forest-on-landscape tutorial.
gotchas: Sampling points on Static Meshes needs the PCG Geometry Script Interop plugin
Editor-only Blueprint functions require deriving from PCG Editor Blueprint Element (editor-only)
Bounds-based fitting and overlap checks are not exact mesh collision tests

summary: Reference for the experimental PCG-based Procedural Vegetation Editor (PVE): enabling the plugin, creating vegetation graphs, and nodes such as Grower, Mesh Builder, Foliage Distributor, Graft Distributor, Extract From Image/Mesh, post-growth modifiers and Export to Nanite Foliage.
gotchas: Experimental plugin, off by default; large architectural changes between releases
UE 5.7 PVE assets cannot be opened in 5.8
Do not drop PVE graph output into the world; only exported assets
Grower data cannot be exported directly; needs Mesh Builder output

summary: Explains PCG shape grammar syntax (modules, *, +, [], {} weights, <> priority) and documents the grammar nodes Spline to Segment, Duplicate Cross-Sections, Subdivide Segment, Subdivide Spline, Clean Spline, Spline Direction, Primitive Cross-Section, Select Grammar and Print Grammar.
keys: Silence Grammar Does Not Fit Errors
gotchas: Subdivide Spline may underestimate tight corners
Primitive Cross-Section needs the PCG Geometry Script Interop plugin (Beta, disabled by default)
Spline Direction nodes saved before UE 5.6 may warn and should be replaced
Spline Direction can lose spline component user data

summary: How PCG-generated actors inherit World Partition Data Layers and HLOD Layers, the Data Layer and HLOD source settings on Spawn Actor/Create Target Actor, and the Get Actor Data Layers and Partition By Actor Data Layers nodes.
gotchas: Using Included Data Layers ignores all other Data Layers

summary: Hub page for level and environment building topics (Starting Out and Content Guides sections); no content beyond the section headings in this extract.

How to create and assign a Water Waves asset to Water Bodies, tune Gerstner wave parameters (count, seed, wavelength, amplitude, wind direction, steepness), and write a custom wave generator in C++ or Blueprint.
gotchas: Only the Gerstner model ships with the engine
Micro surface detail should come from the water material normal maps, not waves

summary: Explains the SingleLayerWater shading model: its render pass, setting Opaque/Masked blend mode, and the Single Layer Water Material output inputs (scattering, absorption, PhaseG, Color Scale Behind Water) plus Opacity behaviour.
gotchas: Blend Mode must be Opaque or Masked
Low-end and mobile fall back to simple translucency without volume integration or SSR
Color Scale Behind Water is a visual effect only; it does not project real caustics or shadows
